Blnk (Apache-2.0, on disk) implements statement matching and reconciliation over an immutable double-entry ledger. Go, so it is a model reference for our NestJS/Drizzle side, not portable code.
Blnk's immutable-ledger model is the reference for reversal by compensating entry rather than mutation. The authorisation and reversibility policy has no source.

moov-io/watchman (Apache-2.0) is the identified reference but is NOT on disk and was deliberately not downloaded. Screening needs list ingestion plus fuzzy name matching, neither of which exists in the kit.
No reusable implementation in the kit and no local source under `sources/` covers it as of 2026-09-27; features/, backend/, components/, patterns/, ai/, mobile/ and starters/ are all still empty.
Threshold configuration and cumulative-window aggregation; nothing in the kit or on disk covers it. Jurisdiction-specific thresholds stay a human-review item in compliance.json.
